evidence: In situ Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), along with a quadrupole mass spectrometer (Q-mass), was used to study the gas phase and surface chemistry of ALD reactions with TBTDET. The chemical composition and phase composition of the film were measured with Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS) and an X-ray photoelectron spectroscope (XPS). The density of the film was measured with XRR. The film resistivity was calculated from the sheet resistance measured by the four-point probe method, and the film thickness was measured with a field-emission-scanning electron microscope (FE-SEM) and X-ray reflectivity (XRR).
